subject: Operations

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No retry with backoff for transient database failures
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded retry with exponential backoff and jitter for transient connection errors (e.g. Polly/Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience, or provider retry options such as EnableRetryOnFailure/Npgsql retry).

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No circuit breaker (or equivalent) protecting calls to the database dependency
findings.recommendation: Wrap data access in a resilience pipeline with a circuit breaker so a degraded database fails fast instead of tying up request threads; note the health check also does not probe the database.

strengths.subject: Operations
strengths.title: Connection timeout is configurable per data source (30s) and the request CancellationToken is propagated to the database command
